Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) content on Yelp is generated via OpenAI.
AI content at Yelp may be trained on Yelp platform content, like reviews, or on training sets provided through third party services, like GPT-4.
We are constantly working to improve the Yelp experience, and our use of AI, to provide you with helpful information.
That said, AI is a rapidly evolving technology and may sometimes include inaccurate information.
To provide feedback on this content, please email us at ProductFeedback@yelp.com.

Search Support Center Yelp For Consumers Posting Photos & Videos Does Yelp allow posting reviews generated by AI software?
Any reviews created with AI software violate Yelp’s Content Guidelines , as reviewers must write their own reviews based on their own direct firsthand consumer experiences at businesses.
Use of chatbots or other AI tools to create reviews, including using such tools to draft or revise, are subject to removal and repeated violations may result in account closure, per our Terms of Service .
Please visit our Content Guidelines and Trust & Safety sites to learn more about how Yelp moderates content.
